correctness.rationale: For x>0 rotate and scale the value and derivative coefficients to get the span of u_j=sqrt(p_j) and j u_j, where p_j=(1−x)^β(β)_j x^j/j!. Differentiating the binomial generating function gives mean μ=βx/(1−x) and variance σ²=βx/(1−x)². Orthonormalizing with the centered linear polynomial gives the exact diagonal projection p_n(1+(n−μ)²/σ²). At x=0 the span is that of 1,z, orthogonal to e_n for n≥2; the two endpoints of the radial formula have limit zero. Write h=n+β, D=n−hx. Removing the positive derivative prefactor (a_n/β)x^(n−2)(1−x)^(β−1) leaves (D−(1−x))(βx+D²)+x(1−x)(β−2hD) = D[h(h+1)x²−2nhx+n(n−1)]. The discriminant is 4nh(β+1); t²=n(β+1)/h satisfies t<n, t<β+1 and ht>n. Thus the roots have exactly the claimed order, and the signs +,−,+,− give the exhaustive two-peak radial maximum, with all optimizing angular rotations. For fixed β the Gamma-ratio asymptotic and elementary binomial limit give the stated limit profile uniformly on compact c-intervals with x=1−c/n; both critical scales tend to positive c±=β+1±sqrt(β+1). At each, the profile bracket is 2c±/β. With s=sqrt(β+1), the log of the ratio of the larger-c to smaller-c limiting height is s² log((s+1)/(s−1))−2s>0, by the integral or series for artanh. This proves eventual strict smaller-radius superiority without interchanging an uncontrolled supremum and limit. At β=2 the constant reduces to (3+sqrt(3))³ exp(−3−sqrt(3))=0.933350239090664… .
residual_risks: Strict maxima are radial; the corresponding optimizing nodes come in circles. No finite-degree universal ranking, uniformity in β, or distinct-node approximation is inferred.

value.rationale: The value/first-derivative span is a basic two-measurement operation at a repeated sampling node. The exact radial optimization over the disk and the explicit strict high-degree peak selection make this a quantitative benchmark for the minimal jet, not just another standard orthogonal-polynomial normalization. In contrast with the known Fock tie or higher-order transition, the separate two-dimensional Gamma comparison determines where an optimal node sits and what fraction it captures.
residual_risks: No downstream reconstruction guarantee or advantage over two distinct sampling nodes is asserted.
